## The object

The figure-eight knot complement **m004** -- the unique arithmetic knot complement, trace
field `Q(sqrt-3)`. The programme asks what such an object forces, and reports that it forces
**form** while refusing **values**. Most results are therefore negatives, and that is the
result, not the debt.

**PROVED — `B1443`** (1649 words, 1 locks)  
THE ORBIT'S COUPLING TENSOR. For a deck orbit of generation-shaped backgrounds with distinct extension characters, B1438 gives Y(i, j; k) = y [i = j] [eta_i = eta_k]: member i couples only to the spin-0 character of its own data, with one strength y for the whole orbit, so the tensor's shape is the number of distinct Higgs characters the orbit couples to. Checked directly on two levels with every character tried as the Higgs: a non-zero coupling for exactly one character per background, 48 of 48. Tabulated by slopes on all 18 788 deck orbits of the 142 levels of the census to length twelve: of 4 904 orbits of three, 4 464 have one Higgs character per member for both the up and the down coupling and 440 have one for all three in some coupling; on the root's three-fold cover ALL 16 orbits have three distinct Higgs characters for the up, the down-and-lepton and the neutrino couplings, every one non-zero, which holds for every orbit on only one other three-fold level of 25. By linear algebra the mass matrix of such an orbit is y diag(v_k): mass ratios are the ratios of the Higgs values, there is no mixing, the deck-symmetric point is degenerate and a single class gives rank one. Computed in answer to the owner's question why 'copies that cannot be told apart' should be a blocker: it was an imported expectation; the frame supplies a separate Higgs class per member. Checked again at the owner's instruction: that no invariant singles out a member (verified directly here; the three arcs first cited concern other orbits) does NOT mean the pattern of the Higgs values is not supplied -- the unordered pattern is an invariant, and a deck-invariant function with unsymmetric minima is not excluded by anything proved; none has been looked for. First candidate: on the root's three-fold cover the product of an orbit's three Higgs characters is trivial, so a cubic joining them is character-allowed; not computed. The reading as three generations is fenced as speculation with the computations it would need. No value; no physics claim.

## How to falsify any of this

1. Every closure names an **escape hatch** -- the computation that would reopen it. Pick a
   door in `CLOSED_DOORS.md`, run its hatch; the door holds or it does not.
2. Every PROVED arc names its **test locks**. Run them.
3. The gates (`python3 scripts/gates/gates.py`) enforce the governance invariants, and each
   was verified by deliberate breakage -- a gate never observed to fail is not a gate.

You do not need to read the record to check the programme. That is the point of this page.
